long_biography.plain_text:
Pons established a residential lettings agency in New York in 1995, aiming to connect landlords and tenants without a traditional broker. He automated the model, registered EasyRent online and created EasyRoommate for room sharing. The service expanded from the United States into Canada and Europe while remaining under companies he controlled.

Using the same digital platform, Pons and his team launched Vivastreet as a broader classified-advertising business. He built W3 without outside investment, relying on profitable operations and retaining majority control while granting equity to employees. Pons subsequently used the group to finance early-stage marketplace companies. He remains controlling shareholder and sole active director of Digital Directories Limited, an information-services business, after ending control of Digital Ventures Holding in 2024.
